description.p: AniCal keeps a local library of the anime you follow and shows when new episodes air, in day, week and month views.

ul.li: Imports your MyAnimeList list (read-only) or works entirely offline with shows you add yourself
Exact airing times from AniList, with clearly marked estimates when only a weekly slot is known
Plays episodes through your existing ani-cli installation and marks them watched when you finish
Notifies you when a new episode is probably available

description.p: Your library and watch history stay on your computer.
Runs on macOS and Windows as well as Linux. Playback can also open a link or run a command instead of ani-cli, and ani-cli now keeps AniCal's show picker even when rofi or dmenu is installed.
First release: library, MyAnimeList import, airing calendar, ani-cli playback and notifications.
